title: Fix Kit Diagram And Table File Sync
description: Patch the sketchpad kit app so the D3 diagram and table windows stay synchronized for file and folder artifacts. Only render file and folder elements that have actual readable references, and show those referenced artifacts in both windows. Extend existing inline Playwright coverage and run the Kit test slice.
summary: Fixed kit file and folder sync between the sketchpad table and D3 diagram by wiring both views to the same readable file-reference source. Replaced the placeholder file-url hook with a live kit-store subscription, extracted shared referenced-artifact filtering, applied it to table rows and diagram nodes, extended the existing inline Kit Playwright coverage for file/folder sync counts, and excluded Playwright-only modules from Vite dependency optimization. Verification: esbuild ESM syntax pass succeeded. Full vite build still gets killed with exit 137 during chunk rendering, workspace-wide TypeScript reports many unrelated pre-existing errors, and dev boot still hits separate pre-existing Vite scan failures in this repo shape.
